description: This Java file 'IncomingRequestPhoneService.java' defines a service class that extends WearableListenerService to handle incoming messages from wear devices. It processes requests related to storage permissions and data, responds appropriately, and manages communication with wear nodes, including prompting user permissions and listing external storage directories.

classes.name: IncomingRequestPhoneService
classes.description: A service class extending WearableListenerService to handle incoming messages and permissions requests from wearable devices, interacting with storage and permissions.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, determines request type, and directs to appropriate response functions.

methods.name: promptUserForStoragePermission
methods.description: Checks storage permission; if granted, sends approval, otherwise launches an activity to request permission from the user.

methods.name: respondWithStorageInformation
methods.description: Checks permissions and retrieves a list of external storage directories to send back as a message.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Establishes a GoogleApiClient connection, sends a message to a specified node, and logs success or failure.

methods.name: isExternalStorageReadable
methods.description: Checks whether external storage is available and readable.
